reasoning: In mid-March in Dijon, France, temperatures are generally rising as spring approaches. March 22 is one week after March 15, so climatologically we'd expect slightly warmer temperatures on average. However, day-to-day weather variability is substantial - individual days can easily be warmer or cooler than the seasonal trend due to weather systems. The standard deviation of daily temperatures in March is typically 3-5°C, while the expected warming over one week is only about 0.5-1°C. Given this high variability relative to the trend, the probability that March 22 is warmer than March 15 is only slightly above 50%, perhaps around 52-55%.
